name: Coyote Thieves
summary: In Kargath, crag coyotes have stolen food, and Neeka Bloodscar wants them hunted. She asks you to bring back thirty jawbones.

sections.title: Thieves of Kargath
sections.body: Neeka Bloodscar asks whether you have spent many days in the Badlands, felt its heat, and met the beasts of its dusty plains. Crag coyotes are tough, and they have crept into Kargath to steal food from the outpost. She wants you to hunt them and bring back their jawbones. Bring enough, and Neeka may believe you know the Badlands.

faq.q: Why does Neeka Bloodscar want coyote jawbones?
faq.answer: Crag coyotes have crept into Kargath and stolen food from the outpost. Neeka wants them hunted, and their jawbones will show that you know the Badlands.

faq.q: Where are the coyotes causing trouble?
faq.answer: Crag coyotes wander the Badlands' dusty plains and have crept into Kargath to steal food.

faq.q: How many jawbones does Neeka Bloodscar want?
faq.answer: Neeka Bloodscar wants you to bring her thirty coyote jawbones in Kargath.
Neeka Bloodscar is at the Kargath outpost in the Badlands. She asks you to hunt crag coyotes.
